page.overview:
Who is Eidys Dwendal?

Prince Eidys Dwendal is the prince of the Dwendalian Empire, and the heir of his father's throne as of 835 PD.

Eidys is a skilled and physically strong man.

Eidys used to be a happy man who enjoyed an extravagant lifestyle, but he wasn't able to win his father's approval, leaving him jaded, dejected and bitter.

Eidys was born from the marriage of King Bertrand and Queen Duvia, growing up to become the sole heir to the Empire, although less politically skilled than his parents. When he reached an appropriate age he married Suria Saugiss, a member of an influential noble house in the Empire. They were expected to produce the next heir in the line of succession, but so far they have not been able to.
